core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette on Streatham High Road, SW16
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on the first and second floors above a commercial unit on Streatham High Road, SW16, with its own entrance and a bay-fronted living room. A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer.

The first floor has a bay-fronted living room measuring 4.90m x 4.10m into bay (16'1" x 13'5" into bay) and a kitchen measuring 3.20m x 2.30m (10'6" x 7'7") fitted in 2022. The second floor has two bedrooms measuring 3.85m x 3.05m (12'8" x 10'0") and 2.70m x 2.40m (8'10" x 7'10"), and a bathroom.

Access to the rear entrance is via a service yard shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. There is no parking; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approx. 6 minutes' walk, and Streatham Common is approx. 10 minutes' walk.

Offers in Excess of £375,000 for the leasehold with 89 years remaining. Ground rent is £350 per year and doubles every 25 years; the next increase is in 2034. The service charge is £960 per year (year ending December 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C (London Borough of Lambeth). EPC rating D. Construction is standard: brick under a slate roof. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road, and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. There is access via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and a shared bin store. Chain involved.
